config:
hostname edge1
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
 ip address 10.30.0.1 255.255.255.0
 ip nat inside
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
 ip address 203.0.113.1 255.255.255.252
 ip nat outside
 no shutdown
!
ip access-list standard NAT-SRC
 permit 10.30.0.0 0.0.0.255
!
ip nat pool PUBPOOL 198.51.100.16 198.51.100.31 netmask 255.255.255.0
ip nat inside source list NAT-SRC pool PUBPOOL overload
!

hostname edge1
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
 ip address 10.31.0.1 255.255.255.0
 ip nat inside
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
 ip address 203.0.113.1 255.255.255.252
 ip nat outside
 no shutdown
!
ip access-list extended INSIDE-NETS
 permit ip 10.31.0.0 0.0.0.255 any
!
ip nat inside source list INSIDE-NETS interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0 overload
!

hostname edge1
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
 ip address 10.32.0.1 255.255.255.0
 ip nat inside
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
 ip address 203.0.113.1 255.255.255.252
 ip nat outside
 no shutdown
!
ip access-list standard NAT-SRC
 permit 10.32.0.0 0.0.0.255
!
ip nat pool SMALLPOOL 203.0.113.32 203.0.113.47 netmask 255.255.255.240
ip nat inside source list NAT-SRC pool SMALLPOOL
!

hostname switch1
!
vlan 100
!
interface Vlan100
 ip address 10.100.0.2 255.255.255.0
 standby 5 ip 10.100.0.1
 standby 5 priority 120
 standby 5 preempt
 no shutdown
!

hostname router1
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
 ip address 10.10.10.2 255.255.255.0
 standby 1 ip 10.10.10.1
 standby 1 priority 110
 standby 1 preempt
 standby 1 track GigabitEthernet0/0/0 20
 no shutdown
!

hostname router1
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
 ip address 10.10.10.2 255.255.255.0
 standby 1 ip 10.10.10.1
 standby 1 priority 110
 standby 1 preempt
 standby 1 name CORE-GW
 no shutdown
!

hostname router1
!
ip access-list extended PROBE23
 permit tcp any any eq 22
 permit udp any any eq 123
 deny ip any any
!

hostname switch1
!
vlan 100
!
interface Vlan100
 ip address 10.100.0.2 255.255.255.0
 standby 5 ip 10.100.0.1
 standby 5 priority 120
 standby 5 preempt
 standby 5 name CORE-GW
 no shutdown
!
